company_profile: Delivery Hero is a Berlin-based local delivery platform operating in around 65 countries, connecting customers with restaurants and shops.
title: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years applying ML in production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, from offline experimentation and evaluation to deployment and monitoring. Improves retrieval and ranking quality with a fine-tuned cross-encoder reranker, embedding-based dense retrieval and recommendation re-ranking, working in PyTorch, scikit-learn, PySpark and SQL. Also builds LLM agents and automated evaluation pipelines, and explains model trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.original: Fine-tuned a cross-encoder on positive and negative pairs
experience_edits.new: Fine-tuned a cross-encoder on pairwise positive and negative examples to re-rank dense embedding retrieval over AARP survey data, improving retrieval accuracy.

experience_edits.original: Implemented a reranker for an existing recommendation system
experience_edits.new: Implemented a reranker for a live recommendation system serving individual and child plan recommendations, improving renewal suggestions and increasing conversion by 2%.

experience_edits.new: Built automated evaluation and monitoring pipelines for Question Answering and Summary Agents with LLM evaluators, tracing and failure detection, reducing human-in-the-loop review by 43%.

experience_edits.new: Deployed and monitored a production SLA breach prediction model with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow, using GPT-3.5 for real-time root-cause analysis and remediation per breach, reducing downtime by 67%.

project.name: Neural Search Ranking Model
bullets: Built a two-tower retrieval and deep ranking model in PyTorch for product search, learning query and item embeddings and re-ranking candidates with pairwise learning-to-rank.
Evaluated rankers offline with NDCG and MRR against a gradient-boosted baseline, tracked experiments in MLflow, and served the model through FastAPI with latency and drift monitoring.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist role in the Search Ranking team. In my data science work I have improved retrieval and ranking more than once, from fine-tuning a cross-encoder reranker to adding a reranker to a live recommendation system. What ties it together is carrying models from offline experiments into production and watching them there.

Search is where a customer decides in seconds whether the app understood them, and ranking across many markets and languages at Delivery Hero is a problem I want to work on. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and I am building my career in the city where we are making our home.

I would bring production discipline and fast experimentation. My reranker on an existing recommendation system lifted conversion by 2%, and the automated evaluation pipelines I built for our Question Answering and Summary Agents cut human review by 43%, the kind of setup that makes reviewing many experiment runs manageable.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me focused on what users actually see, not only on offline metrics. I would be glad to talk about the team's ranking roadmap.
